fixed.zh: 保存暂时不可用，请稍后重试。
fixed.en: Saving is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

fixed.zh: 请先打开网页，等待页面加载完成后再保存。
fixed.en: Open a webpage and wait for it to finish loading before saving.

fixed.zh: 候选已过期，请重新检测当前页面。
fixed.en: The candidate has expired. Detect media on the current page again.

fixed.zh: 该资源受保护或格式未支持，未开始保存。
fixed.en: This resource is protected or its format is unsupported. Saving has not started.

fixed.zh: ②流媒体保存需要有效权益。本开发版本没有真实购买入口。
fixed.en: ② Stream saving requires a valid entitlement. This development version has no real purchase entry point.

fixed.zh: 已有保存或系统媒体校验正在退出，请稍后再试。
fixed.en: An existing save or system media verification operation is still shutting down. Please try again later.

fixed.zh: 无法安全建立短期请求会话，未开始保存。
fixed.en: A short-lived request session could not be established safely. Saving has not started.

fixed.zh: ①直接下载任务已接受，请在保存任务查看进度。
fixed.en: ① The Direct download task has been accepted. View its progress in Save tasks.

fixed.zh: ②流媒体保存暂不可用，请检查权益并等待现有任务退出。
fixed.en: ② Stream saving is temporarily unavailable. Check your entitlement and wait for existing tasks to shut down.

fixed.zh: 无法建立短期请求会话。
fixed.en: A short-lived request session could not be established.

fixed.zh: 流媒体检查队列暂不可用，未开始保存。
fixed.en: The stream inspection queue is temporarily unavailable. Saving has not started.

fixed.zh: 页面、来源或权益已变化，请重新检查。
fixed.en: The page, source, or entitlement has changed. Check again.

fixed.zh: 保存任务容量已满，已有媒体未被删除。
fixed.en: Save task capacity is full. Existing media has not been deleted.

fixed.zh: 已有保存操作处理中。
fixed.en: A save operation is already in progress.

fixed.zh: ②流媒体任务已接受，固定所选清晰度；仅在独立 MP4 通过验证后完成。
fixed.en: ② The Stream task has been accepted with the selected quality fixed. It completes only after the standalone MP4 passes verification.

fixed.zh: 录制会话已中断，不能复用旧授权。请明确开始新录制；旧任务可放弃。
fixed.en: The recording session was interrupted. The old consent cannot be reused. Explicitly start a new recording; the old task can be abandoned.

fixed.zh: 流媒体片段未完成。请返回网页重新选择固定清晰度，新任务从头开始；旧任务可取消。
fixed.en: The stream segments are incomplete. Return to the webpage and select a fixed quality again. The new task starts over; the old task can be cancelled.

fixed.zh: 重启后不会保留完整来源地址。请返回网页重新检测并选择，新任务会从头下载；旧任务可取消。
fixed.en: The full source address is not retained after a restart. Return to the webpage to detect and select media again. The new task downloads from the beginning; the old task can be cancelled.

fixed.zh: 请先在浏览器打开并登录该资源的同源页面，再回来手动继续。
fixed.en: Open and sign in to a same-origin page for this resource in the browser, then return and resume manually.

fixed.zh: 无法安全建立短期请求会话，未继续保存。
fixed.en: A short-lived request session could not be established safely. Saving has not resumed.

fixed.zh: 任务状态暂时无法读取，已保留私有文件供恢复。
fixed.en: The task state cannot be read right now. Private files have been retained for recovery.

fixed.zh: 保存执行队列暂不可用，任务已暂停。
fixed.en: The save execution queue is temporarily unavailable. The task has been paused.

fixed.zh: ③暂不可开始。请检查录制权益，并等待现有保存或预览资源退出。
fixed.en: ③ Recording cannot start right now. Check your recording entitlement and wait for existing save or preview resources to shut down.

fixed.zh: 任务容量或显示尺寸不适合开始录制。
fixed.en: Task capacity or display dimensions are unsuitable for starting a recording.

fixed.zh: 录制会话仍在退出，请稍后重新开始。
fixed.en: The recording session is still shutting down. Start again later.

fixed.zh: 无法建立有效的录制配置。
fixed.en: A valid recording configuration could not be established.

fixed.zh: 选区、权益或媒体资源尚未就绪。请重新核对选区并等待现有任务退出。
fixed.en: The region, entitlement, or media resources are not ready. Check the region again and wait for existing tasks to shut down.

fixed.zh: 当前显示几何、权益或媒体资源尚未就绪，未取得预览或开始录制。
fixed.en: The current display geometry, entitlement, or media resources are not ready. No preview was acquired and recording has not started.

fixed.zh: 系统未能启动本次前台录制服务。旧授权已丢弃，请手动重新开始。
fixed.en: The system could not start this foreground recording service. The old consent has been discarded. Start again manually.

fixed.zh: 录制任务未能结束，私有文件已保留供本地恢复。
fixed.en: The recording task could not finish. Private files have been retained for local recovery.

fixed.zh: 系统录制资源仍未确认退出。已保留前台状态与文件；不能开始另一项录制。必要时请在系统中完全结束应用。
fixed.en: System recording resources have not been confirmed released. The foreground state and files have been retained; another recording cannot start. If necessary, fully stop the app through the system.

fixed.zh: 暂停/继续按现有契约需要录制与片段录制权益。
fixed.en: Under the existing contract, pause and resume require both recording and segment-recording entitlements.

fixed.zh: 保存存储暂时不可用，原有媒体未被清除。
fixed.en: Save storage is temporarily unavailable. Existing media has not been cleared.

fixed.zh: 任务操作较多，请稍后再试。
fixed.en: Too many task operations are pending. Please try again later.

network.en: Saving is waiting for a confirmed default Wi-Fi connection. Connect to Wi-Fi or turn off Save only over Wi-Fi, then retry manually.
network.zh: 正在等待已确认的默认 Wi-Fi 网络。请连接 Wi-Fi，或关闭“仅通过 Wi-Fi 保存”后手动重试。

network.en: Saving preferences are not confirmed yet. Wait for settings to load, or explicitly choose the Wi-Fi saving setting before downloading.
network.zh: 保存设置尚未确认。请等待设置加载，或在设置中明确选择 Wi-Fi 保存选项后再下载。

detection.zh: 页面或标签已变化，请在当前页面重新点击保存。
detection.en: The page or tab has changed. Tap Save again on the current page.

detection.zh: 当前关闭了 JavaScript。启用后可在页面点击保存进行一次检测。
detection.en: JavaScript is currently disabled. After enabling it, tap Save on the page to run one detection.

detection.zh: 页面检测超时，未开始下载。
detection.en: Page detection timed out. Downloading has not started.

detection.zh: 当前资源属于 blob 或其他未支持类型。仅支持 HTTPS MP4 与受限静态 HLS。
detection.en: This resource is a blob or another unsupported type. Only HTTPS MP4 and restricted static HLS are supported.

detection.zh: 当前主页面未找到可检测的视频。跨域播放器、blob 或嵌套页面可能无法检测。
detection.en: No detectable video was found on the current main page. Cross-origin players, blobs, or nested pages may not be detectable.

detection.zh: 页面返回的检测数据无法安全读取，未开始下载。
detection.en: The detection data returned by the page could not be read safely. Downloading has not started.

failures.zh: 正在等待已确认的默认 Wi-Fi 网络。连接 Wi-Fi 或关闭“仅通过 Wi-Fi 保存”后手动重试。
failures.en: Saving is waiting for a confirmed default Wi-Fi connection. Connect to Wi-Fi or turn off Save only over Wi-Fi, then retry manually.

failures.zh: 任务已取消，不会自动换用其他保存方式。
failures.en: The task was cancelled. It will not automatically switch to another saving method.

failures.zh: 资源需要有效的登录会话或访问权限。
failures.en: This resource requires a valid signed-in session or access permission.

failures.zh: 可用存储空间不足。
failures.en: There is not enough available storage space.

failures.zh: 私有存储暂时不可用，未清除已有媒体。
failures.en: Private storage is temporarily unavailable. Existing media has not been cleared.

failures.zh: 操作超时，迟到结果不会提交。
failures.en: The operation timed out. Late results will not be committed.

failures.zh: 网络未能在有限重试内完成，请稍后重试。
failures.en: The network operation did not complete within bounded retries. Please try again later.

failures.zh: 无法验证网站安全连接，未绕过证书检查。
failures.en: The secure connection to the website could not be verified. Certificate checks were not bypassed.

failures.zh: 资源地址或连接不符合安全限制。
failures.en: The resource address or connection does not meet the safety restrictions.

failures.zh: 已达到本开发版本的文件或累计传输预算。
failures.en: The file-size or cumulative transfer budget for this development version has been reached.

failures.zh: 检测到受保护内容，不支持保存。
failures.en: Protected content was detected. Saving is not supported.

failures.zh: 该媒体或保存方式不符合本开发版本的兼容范围。网络保存不支持直播、加密、分轨、格式变化或转码。
failures.en: This media or saving method is outside the compatibility scope of this development version. Network saving does not support live streams, encryption, separate tracks, format changes, or transcoding.

failures.zh: 文件不完整或未通过真实媒体验证，没有作为成功视频入库。
failures.en: The file is incomplete or did not pass actual media verification. It was not added to the library as a successfully saved video.

failures.zh: 源资源或断点身份不一致，没有拼接不匹配的字节。
failures.en: The source resource or resume identity does not match. Mismatched bytes were not joined.

failures.zh: 候选资源已过期，请回到网页重新检测。
failures.en: The candidate resource has expired. Return to the webpage and detect media again.

failures.zh: 系统资源尚未确认退出，任务文件保留，迟到结果不会提交。
failures.en: System resources have not been confirmed released. Task files are retained and late results will not be committed.

failures.zh: 系统媒体校验资源尚未可用，请稍后重试。
failures.en: System media verification resources are not available yet. Please try again later.

failures.zh: 提交状态需要重新核验，文件已保留供恢复。
failures.en: The commit state needs to be verified again. Files have been retained for recovery.

failures.zh: 网站限制了请求，请稍后重试。
failures.en: The website is limiting requests. Please try again later.

failures.zh: 短期来源上下文已清除。请回网页重新检测并选择；新任务从头下载。
failures.en: The short-lived source context has been cleared. Return to the webpage to detect and select media again; the new task downloads from the beginning.

failures.zh: 资源已不存在（404），请回网页重新选择。
failures.en: The resource no longer exists (404). Return to the webpage and select it again.

failures.zh: 网站拒绝了此资源请求，未自动换用其他保存方式。
failures.en: The website rejected this resource request. No automatic switch to another saving method was made.

failures.zh: 网站未返回可保存的完整媒体。
failures.en: The website did not return complete media that can be saved.

failures.zh: 已有任务处理中，请稍后再试。
failures.en: A task is already in progress. Please try again later.

failures.zh: 未获得本次系统录制授权，没有开始录制。
failures.en: System consent for this recording was not obtained. Recording has not started.

failures.zh: 内部声音权限未允许；必须明确选择无声音重新开始，或取消。
failures.en: Internal audio permission was not granted. Explicitly choose to start again without audio, or cancel.

failures.zh: 系统暂时无法开始本次录制；不会重复使用旧授权。
failures.en: The system cannot start this recording right now. The old consent will not be reused.

failures.zh: 设备编码器不支持本次录制配置。
failures.en: The device encoder does not support this recording configuration.

failures.zh: 有效录制样本为空或太短，未发布成片。
failures.en: Valid recording samples are empty or too short. No finished video was published.

failures.zh: 等待录制关键帧超时，未确认完整成片。
failures.en: Waiting for a recording keyframe timed out. A complete finished video has not been confirmed.

failures.zh: 录制媒体时间线不符合要求，未发布成片。
failures.en: The recorded media timeline does not meet the requirements. No finished video was published.

failures.zh: 内部播放音频采集失败；没有自动改用麦克风或无声音。
failures.en: Internal playback audio capture failed. No automatic switch to the microphone or to recording without audio was made.

failures.zh: 系统录制编码器失败，未确认保存成功。
failures.en: The system recording encoder failed. Successful saving has not been confirmed.

failures.zh: 录制文件未完整收尾，未发布成片。
failures.en: The recording file was not fully finalized. No finished video was published.

failures.zh: 任务未完成，请检查页面与存储后重试。
failures.en: The task did not complete. Check the page and storage, then try again.

zh.other: 最多同时保留 %1$s 条未完成任务，当前已满。已有媒体未被删除。

en.one: At most %1$s unfinished task can be retained at a time. Capacity is currently full. Existing media has not been deleted.
en.other: At most %1$s unfinished tasks can be retained at a time. Capacity is currently full. Existing media has not been deleted.

verification_scope: Pure JVM/XML/source fixtures only; actual Compose/device rendering and locale switching NOT_RUN
